summary: A month of day keys to pick one day or a range: the picked day is one dark key that slides to the next pick, and a range sinks the days between.

props.name: mode
props.description: Picks one day, or a range from its first day to its last.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The picked day or range on first render, uncontrolled.

props.name: value
props.description: The picked day or range, controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.typeName: (value: Date | DateRange | undefined, day?: Date) => void
props.description: Called with the new day or range whenever it changes, and the day that was clicked.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: The first day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.

props.name: startMonth
props.description: The earliest month to show, and the first year in the list. 100 years back by default.

props.name: endMonth
props.description: The latest month to show, and the last year in the list. 10 years ahead by default.

props.name: sliding
props.description: The picked day's key slides from pick to pick. Off, the picked day fills in place, as suits a popup that closes on the pick.

props.name: footer
props.description: The line under the grid: the picked day and a Today key, or the range and its nights.

props.name: disabledDays
props.description: Days that cannot be picked: a date, a list of them, a range, or a function of the date.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the panel and its day keys. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks picking and dims every day.

props.name: animated
props.description: The picked day's key sliding to the next pick. Turn it off for one that jumps; reduced motion does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the month and year lists are rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.
